description: Metadata for public Centre for International Governance Innovation research and news HTML about artificial intelligence and AI governance on www.cigionline.org and cigionline.org. Research is /publications/ and news is /articles/. Person profiles, donation pages, login walls, PDFs, and unrelated topics stay out. Bounded GETs of those AI pages returned a Cloudflare challenge and were not stored, so this catalog is empty. robots.txt is plain text and allows those paths. sitemap.xml was an HTML challenge. A challenge page, an HTML document in place of robots.txt, a host that does not resolve, or a redirect off these hosts is not stored. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A missing date stays unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
